scope: Two zero-product-byte target timing rows that bound the 480 symbol-value reads inside the accepted 89-frame GC envelope.

candidate_binding.rebind_rule: If a successor product is the next bundled-session candidate, rerun this host gate against its actually bound compiler carrier before measuring.

clock.valid_snapshot: the two high-byte reads are equal
clock.reason: The 1000-read interval may exceed one byte; the old modulo-256 timing contract is not admissible here.

input_transport.rule: Every submitted form must fit the verified-input screen echo. Longer equivalent forms are a harness First Red and are never retried on the device.

compiled_shape_contract.compiler: the compiler carrier actually bound by Link 78
compiled_shape_contract.meaning: Loop, frame snapshots, refills, literal traffic and VM call framing are byte-for-byte matched; only the selected primitive differs.

adjudication.dominant_outcome: If the projected 480-read excess is at least 44.5 frames, Bank-5 symbol-value access is a measured dominant lever and a block-read proposal may be scoped.
adjudication.non_dominant_outcome: If it is below 44.5 frames, this matched measurement does not establish symbol access as dominant; no GC cut is authorized and the remaining trace/arena/sweep split stays unknown.
adjudication.claim_limit: The difference is CALLPRIM-19 minus the form-identical CALLPRIM-57 control. It is not named as the absolute cost of symval_get: the control still performs one resident bitmap lookup per iteration.

reference_only_not_directly_multipliable: sympool_read/symname: a larger bulk transfer with different length amortization
Prim-67 %c2d-byte: a one-byte c2_stream_c2d_read path rather than the symval vm_dma call
cost_constant_applicability.R2_rule: Use the reported microseconds per read directly only for counted 2-byte vm_dma reads. The 399 Prim-67 resolver reads may be compared as scale evidence, but their time is not calculated from this constant without a separate path-equivalence proof.
